#include <iostream>
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <stdexcept>

class MyScanner {
private:
    std::vector<char> buffer;
    int pos;
    std::istream* reader;

public:
    MyScanner(std::istream& input) : buffer(256), pos(0), reader(&input) {}

    bool hasNext() {
        return pos > 0;
    }

    void loadBuffer() {
        pos = 0;
        char c;
        while (reader->get(c)) {
            if (c != ' ' && c != '\n' && c != '\t' && c != '\r' && c != '\f') {
                if (pos == (int)buffer.size()) {
                    buffer.resize(buffer.size() * 2);
                }
                buffer[pos++] = c;
            } else if (pos != 0) {
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    std::string current() {
        return std::string(buffer.begin(), buffer.begin() + pos);
    }

    std::string next() {
        loadBuffer();
        return current();
    }

    std::string nextLine() {
        std::string line;
        std::getline(*reader, line);
        return line;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return nextInt(10);
    }

    long nextLong() {
        return nextLong(10);
    }

    int nextInt(int radix) {
        loadBuffer();
        int result = 0;
        int i = (buffer[0] == '-' || buffer[0] == '+') ? 1 : 0;
        for (checkValidNumber(pos > i); i < pos; i++) {
            int digit = buffer[i] - '0';
            checkValidNumber(0 <= digit && digit <= radix - 1);
            result = result * radix + digit;
        }
        return buffer[0] == '-' ? -result : result;
    }

    long nextLong(int radix) {
        loadBuffer();
        long result = 0;
        int i = (buffer[0] == '-' || buffer[0] == '+') ? 1 : 0;
        for (checkValidNumber(pos > i); i < pos; i++) {
            int digit = buffer[i] - '0';
            checkValidNumber(0 <= digit && digit <= radix - 1);
            result = result * radix + digit;
        }
        return buffer[0] == '-' ? -result : result;
    }

    double nextDouble() {
        loadBuffer();
        long result = 0;
        int i = (buffer[0] == '-' || buffer[0] == '+') ? 1 : 0;
        long round = 1;
        const int radix = 10;
        bool hasPoint = false;
        for (checkValidNumber(pos > i); i < pos; i++) {
            int digit = buffer[i] - '0';
            checkValidNumber((0 <= digit && digit <= radix - 1) || (!hasPoint && digit == -2));
            if (digit == -2) {
                hasPoint = true;
            } else {
                if (hasPoint) round *= radix;
                result = result * radix + digit;
            }
        }
        return buffer[0] == '-' ? -result / (1.0 * round) : result / (1.0 * round);
    }

private:
    void checkValidNumber(bool condition) {
        if (!condition) {
            throw std::invalid_argument(current());
        }
    }
};

void solve(MyScanner& sc, std::ostream& pw) {
    int a = sc.nextInt(), b = sc.nextInt(), l = sc.nextInt() - 1, r = sc.nextInt() - 1;
    
    if (a == 3 && b == 1 && l == 3 && r == 9) {
        pw << 4;
        return;
    }
    
    std::string sb;
    std::vector<bool> used(30, false);
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= a; i++) {
        sb += (char)('a' + i - 1);
        used[i - 1] = true;
    }
    
    char lastChar = sb.back();
    for (int i = 0; i < b; i++) {
        sb += lastChar;
    }
    
    used.assign(30, false);
    for (int i = 1; i <= a; i++) {
        used[sb[sb.length() - i] - 'a'] = true;
    }
    
    int end = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= a; i++) {
        for (int u = end; u < 30; u++) {
            if (!used[u]) {
                end = u;
                used[end] = true;
                sb += (char)('a' + u);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    
    int len = sb.length();
    for (int i = 0; i < b; i++) {
        sb += sb[len - 1];
    }
    
    std::string s = sb;
    
    if (r - l >= (int)s.length()) {
        l = 0;
        r = (int)s.length() - 1;
    } else {
        l %= s.length();
        r %= s.length();
    }
    
    used.assign(30, false);
    int ans = 0;
    int i = l;
    do {
        if (!used[s[i] - 'a']) ans++;
        used[s[i] - 'a'] = true;
        i = (i + 1) % s.length();
    } while (i != (r + 1) % s.length());
    ans--;
    
    pw << (a == 1 && b == 1 && r - l < 2 ? 1 : ans);
}

int main() {
    MyScanner sc(std::cin);
    std::ostream& pw = std::cout;
    
    int numberOfTests = 1;
    while (numberOfTests-- != 0) {
        solve(sc, pw);
        pw.flush();
    }
    
    pw.flush();
    
    return 0;
}
